===Levels 70/80–99: Nightmare Zone===
''For more information, see [[Nightmare Zone/Strategies]].''

Using the normal customisable rumble setup in [[Nightmare Zone]] allows for 20 minutes of AFK Ranged training. After 20 minutes, the player will stop attacking the monsters and needs to interact with the client to start attacking again. Using the [[venator bow]] with [[super ranging|super ranging potions]] and [[absorption]]s offers up to 140,000–150,000 (180,000-190,000 on hard mode) experience per hour at level 99. Slower but cheaper alternatives include the [[Magic shortbow (i)|imbued magic shortbow]] with [[Rune arrow|rune]] or [[amethyst arrow]]s, or [[adamant dart]]s with the [[twisted buckler]].
